glove_visual_and_kinematic_parity.reference: CSU Chico MECA-440B Team 10 Things Capture Glove (Slide 11 Final CAD)
glove_visual_and_kinematic_parity.palm_chassis: Winged bent-angle radial & ulnar cheek plates + forward sloped palmar apron + elevated horizontal Ø13 mm MCP knuckle shaft + chamfered upper MCP palmar block + dual side cheek camera/sensor pods
glove_visual_and_kinematic_parity.upper_digits: 24 mm Index (twin-bar clevis + chiseled distal block) + 52 mm Coupled Middle-Fourth-Pinkie (twin-strut open ladder + wide chiseled distal paddle) overhanging the C-mouth
glove_visual_and_kinematic_parity.opposing_thumb: Low radial-palmar worm-locked -20/0/+20 deg 3-position opposition turret + enlarged 28 mm pentagonal chiseled thumb block with dorsal alignment ridge
glove_visual_and_kinematic_parity.rotary_hubs: 5 exposed 6-notched dark-grey rotary joint encoder caps matching the glove's 5 Bourns rotary sensors

inherited_engineering_rules_preserved.palm_stability_surface: Moulded twin-eminence Shore A 60 PU palmar saddle + 4x Ohmite FSR07 force zones + chamfered MCP palmar block
inherited_engineering_rules_preserved.transmission_and_palm_packaging: two_drives_per_finger + drives_fixed_in_palm inside enclosed 2-layer 3-deck lower wrist-palm belly (6x Pololu HPCB worm-locked SK78 tendon spools + 7th thumb opposition worm + 500 Hz reflex PCB)
inherited_engineering_rules_preserved.serviceability_and_table_pinch: Removable M1.6 dorsal tip service crowns + 1+1+3 flush Contactile 3DFBS-12T-50N domes + 0.50 mm flat-bevel table pen pinch (GR3-PEN-01)

bolt_interface.bilateral_rule: Un-mirrored Ø52x6 mm base_disc so both Right and Left hands lock onto any standardized Wrist_Tool_Changer_R2

minimal_motion_retargeting.equation: q_r4 = I_6 @ q_glove  (exact 6x6 identity matrix, gain = 1.000, offset = 0.000 rad)

channel_map_6dof.glove_sensor: Bourns Rotary 4 (Thumb Flexion, 28 deg fixed block)

observation_space_parity.tactile_9ch: 1x Thumb + 1x Index + 3x Coupled Ulnar + 4x Palmar Saddle (direct 1:1 channel index match)
observation_space_parity.egocentric_rgb: Radial cheek ArduCam wedge at identical T_palm_to_cam extrinsics
